title: Exact Cosine of pi over Three
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the exact value of $\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ by reasoning with the unit circle rather than a calculator.

steps.title: Locate the Angle
steps.explanation: The terminal side of $\pi/3$ lies in the first quadrant, $60^{\circ}$ from the positive $x$-axis.
steps.why: Quadrant position fixes the signs of all trig functions.

steps.title: Apply the Equilateral-Triangle Ratio
steps.explanation: Bisecting a unit equilateral triangle shows the adjacent leg is half the hypotenuse at $60^{\circ}$.
steps.why: The $60^{\circ}$-$60^{\circ}$-$60^{\circ}$ construction is the source of these exact values.

steps.title: Read the Unit-Circle Coordinate
steps.explanation: At $\pi/3$ the point on the unit circle has $x$-coordinate $1/2$, and cosine equals that $x$-coordinate.
steps.why: Cosine is defined as the horizontal coordinate on the unit circle.
